defense_news.title: US Air Force looks to acquire target drones that can mimic stealth jets
defense_news.summary: The U.S. Air Force wants to acquire target drones that can mimic the performance of a variety of aircraft, from stealth fighters to small UAVs.

defense_news.title: German drone maker Helsing enlists Rakuten to broker Japan military deal
defense_news.summary: German drone maker Helsing has enlisted Japanese e-commerce and finance firm Rakuten to help finalize a deal to sell its unmanned systems to Japan’s army.

defense_news.title: Trump orders Pentagon to cut back military exercises with South Korea
defense_news.summary: President Trump instructed the Pentagon to “substantially reduce” joint military exercises with long-term Asian ally South Korea.

defense_news.title: US Space Force, Japan launch sensor to bolster space surveillance above Indo-Pacific
defense_news.summary: In a bilateral space effort, the U.S. Space Force successfully launched a Space Domain Awareness payload aboard Japan’s Quasi-Zenith Satellite 7.
